<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
player = gt = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O': player = n

print(f"Step {current_frame.step}: Player {player['boundary']}, Target {gt['boundary']}")

# Advance 5 steps
result = action(['RIGHT'] * 5)

seg = current_frame.segmentation

    if n['color'] == 'O': player = n
    elif n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] == 3: gt = n

print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")

# Check if they overlapped
if player and gt:
    p_cols = sorted([b[1] for b in player['boundary']])
    g_cols = sorted([b[1] for b in gt['boundary']])
    p_rows = sorted([b[0] for b in player['boundary']])
    g_rows = sorted([b[0] for b in gt['boundary']])
    col_overlap = max(0, min(p_cols[-1], g_cols[-1]) - max(p_cols[0], g_cols[0]) + 1)
    row_overlap = max(0, min(p_rows[-1], g_rows[-1]) - max(p_rows[0], g_rows[0]) + 1)
    print(f"Overlap: cols={col_overlap}, rows={row_overlap}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
